summary: Preserve the approved Home Assistant absorb-manifest command tree and execute registry, local self-hosted configuration, state-backed, calendar, raw REST/WebSocket, camera, diagnostic, and Supervisor operations through real transports.
reason: The curated REST source cannot emit the stock configuration-registry, WebSocket, camera, diagnostic, and Supervisor command tree; Home Assistant documents the first four through its REST/WebSocket APIs and Supervisor operations through its separately authorized REST API.
validated_outcome: The generated binary resolves all 41 approved absorb-manifest rows. Registry and event-watch commands use the Home Assistant WebSocket protocol; find, overview, and bulk plan/status read live states; calendar mutations use documented WebSocket commands; raw commands issue authenticated REST/WebSocket requests; camera snapshot uses the camera proxy endpoint; diagnostics issue config/components reads; local file/YAML/theme operations are restricted to an explicitly mounted HASS_CONFIG_DIR with traversal, symlink, secrets, and atomic-write safeguards; and add-on, backup, and update commands issue Supervisor REST requests when a Supervisor URL and app-scoped token are configured. Unknown WebSocket commands become capability-unavailable only after an authenticated server response.
